notes.content:
Small update to fix issue unlocking "Game completed" achievement.

If you solve all the stages by collecting all the items, this achievement will be unlocked.
Thanks for the feedback!

Alysson N. Moraes,
Moraes Game Studio.

notes.title: Small update (1.0.10)
notes.content:
Just a small update to fix an bug when loading the save game from the cloud on another device. All levels with a green light were started with a red light on another device. This has been fixed in this version, just update your game to the latest version.

Alysson N. Moraes - Moraes Game Studio.

notes.title: Railway Islands - first update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/d6e19dde55e5f62a5bf483e159040031ab5ef385.png[/img]

[h1]Version 1.0.1 brings some improvements to the game.[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807930/Railway_Islands__Puzzle/

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2x speed option. When the train starts moving, a new button will appear, click on it to increase the train speed option by 2x.
[*] Camera zoom option. now you can zoom in and out of the camera using the + and - keys on the keyboard or w, s, up arrow and down arrow.
[*] Position of the locomotive button, now the button that starts the train is positioned in the lower center of the screen.
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/f9b6e96159bfd3aa23228d372cb8a05e9d027021.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Music volume not saved.
[/list]


[i]Thanks to everyone who is playing. It's been amazing to read your feedback and see that you're enjoying the game, it's very gratifying! Thank you very, very much for that!

Alysson N. Moraes - Developer.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
Small update to solve a bug in the loading of the last phase played.
This caused the player to be forced to play the last completed level again to unlock the next one, however this only happened if the player closed the game before loading the next level.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/K1KGJey.png[/img]

Thanks for the reviews, this is very important!

[b]See our other game[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592880/Sokocat__Islands/

Att,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[h1]A small update to fix the level status bug.[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uk6cRYC.png[/img]

There are three level states:
[list]
[*] [b]Green:[/b] When the car reaches the end collecting all the items.
[*] [b]Yellow:[/b] When the car reaches the end and does not collect all the items.
[*] [b]Red:[/b] When the car has not reached the end of the stage.
[/list]

The bug made it impossible to get the yellow signal, confusing the player at times. This has been resolved, I hope you are enjoying the game. Your feedback is very important!

[u][i]Remember that in order to obtain the last achievement of the game, you must have a green light at all levels.[/i][/u]

Thanks,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.
